caseNameFull: Lane v. Scott, Director, Texas Department of Criminal Justice, Institutional Division
judges: Application, Execution, Grant, Stay, Stevens, Would

opinions.text:
C. A. 5th Cir. Application for stay of execution of sentence of death, presented to Justice Scalia, and by him referred to the Court, denied.

Justice Stevens and Justice Ginsburg would *910grant the application for stay of execution.
